main_text.head: CAPUT III.
Respondetur ad sextam Aporiam,
De communione inter populum, ubi de patina, & distributione Panis.
main_text.p: Vide Lib. 2. Cap. 16. Part. 3.EXTUM Argumentum nititur falsa definitione communionis: quæ non in eo sita est, ut multi in eandem patinam imponant manus, aut quisquam Communicantium in ullam patinam imponat manum; neque ut alii aliis panem porrigant: nihil enim istorum legitur in institutione divina: sed in eo, ut omnes unius panis simus participes, sicut docet Apostolus, 1. Corint. 10. 17. Imo frangere & dare panem actiones sunt sacramentales, ad solum ministrum seu pastorem pertinentes, ut patet ex institutione: convivis autem nihil aliud imperatur nisi ut accipiant & comedant in recordationem DOMINI. Et DOMINUS Panem quidem Discipulis dedisse dicitur, non autem dicitur Panem eis apposuisse, aut transmisisse.
[Initial "S" decorated, read as "SEXTUM" joined to the first word.]

page.notes: The first word is a woodcut initial S, joined to "EXTUM" (read as SEXTUM). Marginal note lines "Vide Lib. 2." partly damaged; read as Lib. 2 with uncertainty. The line "Cap. 16." and "Part. 3." are clear. Some words in the body are slightly blurred (e.g. "patinam", "dicitur") but legible. The woodcut band at the top is ornament only.
